name: connectwise-automate-mcp
description: Sync your entire ConnectWise Automate fleet into local SQLite and answer cross-client questions the per-server web UI can't: fleet-wide health roll-ups, stale-agent sweeps, patch-compliance-by-client, and overnight drift.

connectwise_automate_server.title: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_SERVER
connectwise_automate_server.description: Your Automate host, e.g. company.hostedrmm.com. Sets CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_SERVER for the endpoint base URL.

connectwise_automate_client_id.title: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_CLIENT_ID
connectwise_automate_client_id.description: Your registered integration clientId GUID, sent as the clientId header on every request (required for ConnectWise Automate v2020.11+).

connectwise_automate_token.title: CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_TOKEN
connectwise_automate_token.description: Sets CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_TOKEN for the ConnectWise Automate MCP server. Get a credential from https://docs.connectwise.com/ConnectWise_Automate.

connectwise_automate_base_url.title: ConnectWise Automate API base URL
connectwise_automate_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from CONNECTWISE_AUTOMATE_SERVER. Set it only to point at a different host.

connectwise_automate_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
connectwise_automate_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ConnectWise Automate requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

connectwise_automate_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
connectwise_automate_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

connectwise_automate_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
connectwise_automate_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

connectwise_automate_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
connectwise_automate_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
